title: Leverage
description:
S04 E10 — The Queen's Gambit Job
Sterling convinces the team to steal a calibration weight for a nuclear reactor during an international chess tournament.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E11 — The Experimental Job
The team must infiltrate the world of secret societies when homeless veterans in the Boston area begin to disappear.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E12 — The Office Job
While trying to uncover an embezzlement scam, the team becomes part of a documentary shooting at the company they are trying to save.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E13 — The Girls' Night Out Job
When a thief targets Parker's friend, Parker, Sophie and Tara track the thief to the Venezuelan Consulate.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E14 — The Boys' Night Out Job
Nate, Eliot and Hardison must intervene when Hurley is caught up in a drug deal.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E15 — The Lonely Hearts Job
When a wealthy businessman asks the team to find his missing wife, they learn the missing woman is part of a ring of grifters running Sweetheart Scams, in which pretty young women woo and wed older men for their money.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E16 — The Gold Job
The team targets a corrupt pair of siblings and steers them through an elaborate treasure hunt.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E17 — The Radio Job
Latimer hires Nate's father to do a heist in a government office; the team must stage a hostage stand-off when they are trapped inside a building.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E18 — The Last Dam Job
The team is forced to recruit old friends and rivals in order to take down Latimer and an enemy from their past.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E01 — The (Very) Big Bird Job
A shipping CEO's cost-cutting measures result in a plane crash; the team cons a CEO into buying the Spruce Goose.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E02 — The Blue Line Job
The team tries to keep a hockey enforcer from sustaining permanent injury in the playoffs.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E03 — The First Contact Job
The team tries to convince a wealthy scientist, who stole from his former research partner, that he has made first contact with aliens.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E04 — The French Connection Job
The team attempts to bring down a restaurateur who destroys lives in his pursuit of fame and money.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E05 — The Gimme a K Street Job
The team must tackle Congress in order to bring down a competitive cheerleading company that profits by putting teenage girls at risk.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E06 — The D.B. Cooper Job
When a dying FBI agent reveals his greatest failure, Nate becomes obsessed with solving the mystery.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E07 — The Real Fake Car Job
The team fakes the discovery of an antique car in order to convince a Wall Street fraud to break the deal that protects him from prosecution.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E08 — The Broken Wing Job
Parker is left behind on the crew's latest job because of her broken leg; Parker discovers a group of thieves are planning a heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E10 — The Frame-Up Job
Nate must use his investigating skills to clear Sophie's name when she is implicated in the theft of a valuable painting.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E09 — The Rundown Job
Col. Vance, Eliot, Hardison and Parker race to stop a terrorist from launching an attack on Washington.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E11 — The Low Low Price Job
The crew sabotages a mega-store in order to keep it from destroying a small town.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E12 — The White Rabbit Job
The team must run a difficult con in order to prevent a businessman from destroying his company and the town it supports.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E13 — The Corkscrew Job
The team travels into Oregon wine country to steal a rare bottle of wine as part of their current con.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E14 — The Toy Job
The team creates a global toy craze to take on a CEO who is about to release a dangerous toy onto the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E15 — The Long Good-bye Job
The team embarks on its riskiest con yet when Nate takes a case linked to his son's death.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E01 — The Too Many Rembrandts Job
When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E02 — The Panamanian Monkey Job
With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E03 — The Rollin' on the River Job
The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E04 — The Tower Job
One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E05 — The Paranormal Hacktivity Job
When a woman believes she is being haunted, Sophie leads Breanna and Parker through a con to convince the two real estate scammers responsible to target Leverage HQ.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E06 — The Card Game Job
The Leverage team dives into the world of a fantasy collectible card game with a devoted following to take down a pharmaceutical bad boy who is price-gouging drugs.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E07 — The Double-Edged Sword Job
The team takes on a brilliant software developer who is selling a facial recognition system that threatens everyone's privacy except his own.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E08 — The Mastermind Job
Sophie must keep her feelings in check when she discovers that someone has written a memoir of the team, casting himself as Nate.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E09 — The Bucket Job
The Leverage team's Holiday good deed goes awry when their attempt to give a small-town librarian the spy-thriller adventure of a lifetime is interrupted by a shadowy spy organization.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E10 — The Unwellness Job
The team tries to expose a wellness guru who is selling fake medicines to vulnerable people.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E11 — The Jackal Job
The team picks the brain of a legendary grifter and tries to find the loot from her best con before her abusive guardian does.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E12 — The Golf Job
An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E13 — The Hurricane Job
Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E14 — The Great Train Job
When a hate group targets two farmers, the team digs deep into a corrupt green energy innovator and plans a traditional train heist.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E15 — The Muddy Waters Job
The team goes undercover on an oil rig to find dirt on a crooked CEO who is covering up oil spills.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E16 — The Harry Wilson Job
The team sneaks into R.I.Z. to stop them from destroying the electrical grid, but they need Harry's help.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E01 — Redemption: The Debutante Job
The team pulls Harry back into the fold to help a journalist investigating corruption.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E02 — The One Man's Trash Job
The crew finds out that a shady plastics exporter whose dumping threatens local waters is smuggling black market antiquities on his barges, and plots to relieve him of his ill-gotten gains.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E03 — The Tournament Job
The team has to infiltrate an e-sports tournament to stop a ruthless team owner from mentally and physically abusing his young players.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E04 — The Date Night Job
While staging a date-night experience for "Parker and Hardison" at a freeport facility, the team comes across another heist in progress and must stop it to save the life of a 13-year-old boy.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E05 — A Walk in the Woods Job
While investigating the mysterious death of Eliot's friend, the team infiltrates an infamous enclave of power to take down the corrupt head of a private security company.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E06 — The Fractured Job
Eliot returns to his hometown and discovers that the runoff from an oil fracking company is now poisoning the water; the crew plots to take down the powerful man behind it all.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E07 — The Big Rig Job
The team infiltrates a trucking company to stop a pair of siblings from stealing their father's company and forcing his employees into indentured servitude.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E08 — The Turkish Prisoner Job
The team uses the true story of a World War I P.O.W. escape to free an innocent man framed by a pair of dirty cops.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E09 — The Pyramid Job
Prompted by Arthur Wilde, the team takes on a husband and wife couple who run a multilevel marketing pyramid scheme that emotionally and financially preys on young mothers.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E10 — The Work-Study Job
After a college professor steals a discovery from his grad student, the Leverage team has to take him down while returning the credit and reputation to the young woman in the process.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E11 — The Belly of the Beast Job
The team reluctantly enlists the help of a naïve but ambitious assistant to take down a predatory music producer; told from the point of view of a regular person.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E12 — The Museum Makeover Job
When a Leverage International team's museum heist goes awry, the crew goes in to finish the job, ultimately realizing they've been lured into a trap by a treacherous old friend.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E13 — The Crowning Achievement Job
When a formidable enemy steals the Maharaja's crown and traps the crew in the museum, they must find a way out and the crown before they go down for the crime.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E01 — The Weekend in Paris Job
On the run from a busted heist in Paris, the team finds themselves taking shelter among oligarchs auctioning off their home nations' precious resources; they have to create a new con to take down the group's ringleader and save an activist.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E02 — The Digital Frankenstein Job
The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber, a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I.; they watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E03 — The Scared Stiff Job
Our team runs the "Christmas Carol" con on a wannabe cryonics mogul who coerces dying patients into exploitative contracts bankrupting the loved ones they leave behind.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E04 — The Hustler Job
The crew takes on a phone scamming ring that uses deepfake technology to con their marks, run by an old school hustler who came up via the pool hall circuit; to infiltrate his organization, they have to best him on and off the felt.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E05 — The Grand Complication Job
When Sophie is abducted, rivals Parker and Astrid are forced into a desperate race against time to save her by securing the elusive Marie Antoinette watch; unaware of each other's involvement, they embark on a high stakes quest to save Sophie.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E06 — The Swipe Right Job
Sophie's return to dating goes awry when her newest flame is a billionaire, swindling men and women to fund his lavish lifestyle; to dismantle his million dollar scheme, the team must create the perfect romantic specimen and bait the catfish.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E07 — The Shakedown in Clone-Town Job
Sophie, Eliot and Parker get caught in a small-town speed trap run by a corrupt mayor; they decide to help the oppressed townspeople wrest power from his hungry clutches.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E08 — The Cooling off the Mark Job
Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew; he must take point on one of the most delicate parts of the con the Cool Off; despite the crew's help, the situation spins out of control.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E09 — The Polygeist Job
The crew pulls a con to take down a corrupt tech guru claiming to better the world using effective altruism; they target his company's close-knit group of executives, but things get complicated when the group turns out to be much closer.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E10 — The Side Job
Parker decides to take down a local factory kingpin using child labor; the villain spins his own version of how he was wrongfully destroyed, the team tries to unravel the con Parker's running; the team must play catch up.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E01 — The Nigerian Job
After recovering stolen airplane designs, Nate's team must figure out how to return them to the rightful owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E02 — The Homecoming Job
In order to help a wounded reservist, the team tries to expose the truth about a security firm.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E07 — The Wedding Job
The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E09 — The Snow Job
The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E08 — The Mile High Job
All the evidence the team seeks to expose a cover-up is on a plane heading to the Cayman Islands; airborne, the team uncovers a more sinister situation.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E03 — The Two Horse Job
The team travels to Kentucky to help a horse trainer who lost everything when the racehorses he trains were killed in a fire.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E05 — The Bank Shot Job
Nate, Sophie and the mark are taken hostage during a bank robbery; the team tries to help the two amateur and desperate robbers.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E04 — The Miracle Job
Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E06 — The Stork Job
The team goes after an adoption company that is scamming couples looking to adopt war orphans; the team hijacks the production of a horror movie.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E11 — The Juror No. 6 Job
One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E10 — The 12 Step Job
The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E12 — The First David Job
The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E13 — The Second David Job
Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E01 — The Beantown Bailout Job
Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.
